title: Same Evidence, Different Answers: Canonical-Context On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.30251v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often solve a task when all instructions are given in a single prompt, but fail when the same information is revealed gradually across turns. When a clean FULL prompt and a RAW-SHARDED conversation contain the same complete user evidence, the model should still arrive at the same answer. We argue that a key reason for this gap is self-anchored drift: responses produced under partial information introduce unsupported assumptions, and those assumptions later distort the final answer. To reduce this effect, we propose Canonical-Context On-Policy Distillation (CCOPD). During training, the same base model is used in two roles: a frozen teacher conditioned on the clean FULL prompt and a trainable student that receives the same evidence incrementally through a multi-turn conversation; CCOPD aligns the student's behavior on its own trajectories with the teacher's canonical full-context behavior. translated_title: 相同证据，不同答案：面向多轮语言模型的规范上下文同策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）在所有指令一次性给出时通常能够完成任务，但当相同的信息在多轮对话中逐步揭示时却常常失败。当一个干净的完整（FULL）提示和一个分片的多轮（RAW-SHARDED）对话包含相同的完整用户证据时，模型理应得出相同的答案。我们认为造成这一差距的一个关键原因是自我锚定漂移：在部分信息下生成的回复会引入缺乏依据的假设，而这些假设随后会扭曲最终答案。为了减少这种影响，我们提出了规范上下文同策略蒸馏（CCOPD）。在训练过程中，同一个基础模型扮演两个角色：一个以干净的完整提示为条件的冻结教师模型，以及一个通过多轮对话逐步接收相同证据的可训练学生模型；CCOPD 将学生模型在自身轨迹上的行为与教师模型在规范完整上下文下的行为对齐。仅训练……（原文摘要到此被截断）
tldr: 提出规范上下文同策略蒸馏（CCOPD），让同一基础模型分别担任基于完整提示的冻结教师与逐步接收分片证据的多轮学生，并将学生在自身轨迹上的行为与教师的规范全上下文行为对齐，从而缓解多轮对话中的自我锚定漂移，使模型在证据相同时无论以完整提示还是分片对话呈现都能给出一致的答案。
en_tdlr: CCOPD distills a frozen teacher conditioned on the clean full-context prompt into a trainable student that receives the same evidence incrementally across turns, aligning the student's behavior on its own trajectories with the teacher's canonical behavior to mitigate self-anchored drift, so LLMs produce consistent answers when the identical evidence is presented in one prompt or gradually across a multi-turn conversation.
